covers: Wednesday 28 October 2026, 09:15 to 14:40 SAST: oil and gas after the Houthi strikes and a Qatari peace draft for Iran, gold easing, US futures and Alphabet's chip report, Moody's on the budget update, the rand and JSE, ahead of tonight's Fed decision
headline: Wall Street opens quietly before the Fed: S&P 500 +0.17%, Nasdaq +0.24%, Dow -0.08%; Iran rejects Qatar's ideas, oil holds near $115
summary: The rand was at R16.68 per dollar at 06:52 GMT and the Top 40 about 0.2% lower in early trade (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 28 Oct), while Moody's called the budget update credit positive for South Africa's Ba2 rating, which has a positive outlook (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 26 Oct). Wall Street opened mixed at 09:35 ET, with the S&P 500 up 0.17% at 7,735.56, the Nasdaq up 0.24% at 26,541.61 and the Dow down 0.08% at 52,335.43 as memory-chip stocks rose after SK Hynix's results (Reuters via MarketScreener, 28 Oct); the Fed decides at 20:00 SAST and Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close (Reuters via Investing.com, 28 Oct). Brent was $114.87, up 0.87%, at 10:00 GMT after Saudi Arabia said it intercepted a Houthi missile aimed at Taif and Qatari mediators gave Iran a new draft deal (The National, 28 Oct), though a senior Iranian official told Reuters the plan contained only "unacceptable ideas and not an offer" (Investing.com, 28 Oct); spot gold slipped 0.4% to $4,045.45 at 11:08 GMT as the dollar firmed (Investing.com, 28 Oct).

items.title: Iran: Qatar's latest mediation holds only "unacceptable ideas"
items.summary: A senior Iranian official involved in the talks told Reuters on 28 October that Qatar offered "unacceptable ideas and not an offer" and that Tehran's nuclear position is unchanged. Qatar's seven-day draft, presented on Sunday, had a reply expected by the end of the week. Oil was above $115 a barrel after a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery (Reuters via Investing.com, 28 Oct). This lowers hopes of a quick reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Oil: Brent $114.87 as Saudi Arabia intercepts a missile and Qatar puts a new deal to Iran
items.summary: Brent was up 0.87% at $114.87 a barrel and WTI up 1.59% at $101.49 at 2pm UAE time (10:00 GMT), having been up more than 2% earlier. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Taif on Wednesday morning; Saudi Arabia has not confirmed the earlier claimed strikes. Qatari mediators presented Iran with a new draft deal to end the war, and Tehran is expected to reply by the end of the week, an official told Reuters (The National, 28 Oct). US EIA crude stock data is due at 16:30 SAST.

items.title: European gas at a four-year high after Houthi claims on Saudi energy sites
items.summary: The front-month Dutch TTF contract rose 1.2% to EUR97.35 per megawatt-hour on Wednesday, its highest in roughly four years, after the Houthis said on Tuesday they targeted Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery with a ballistic missile; earlier attacks hit pumping stations on the East-West crude pipeline. There was no independent confirmation from Saudi authorities (Investing.com, 28 Oct). Higher gas and oil prices feed into fuel and import costs for South Africa.

items.title: Israel: Netanyahu's bloc falls to 55 seats with just over half the vote counted
items.summary: With 51.5% of votes counted at about 07:37 Israel time, the pro-Netanyahu bloc had 55 seats, Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc 49 and the Arab parties 16; 61 seats are needed for a majority. Earlier, at 41.9% counted, the bloc had 57 (Times of Israel, 28 Oct). About 650,000 double-envelope ballots, including soldiers', are counted separately and the process could run into Friday, so the numbers may still change (Ynet, 27–28 Oct).

items.title: Wall Street opens mixed before the Fed; chips lift the Nasdaq
items.summary: At 09:35 ET on 28 October the S&P 500 was up 13.0 points (0.17%) at 7,735.56, the Nasdaq Composite up 63.8 points (0.24%) at 26,541.61 and the Dow down 42.1 points (0.08%) at 52,335.43. Memory-chip makers climbed after SK Hynix's results, ahead of tonight's Fed decision and Microsoft and Alphabet results after the close.

items.title: US futures mixed before the Fed; Micron +4%, Robinhood -8% pre-market
items.summary: At 04:53 ET Nasdaq 100 futures were up 0.41%, S&P 500 futures up 0.1% and Dow futures down 0.17%. Before the open Micron rose 4% and SK Hynix's US shares 7.8% after SK Hynix's sevenfold profit jump, Seagate fell 3.7% after its results and Robinhood 8% after missing profit estimates. The Fed decides at 2pm ET (20:00 SAST) (Reuters via Investing.com, 28 Oct).

items.title: US goods trade deficit widens to $134.9 billion in September
items.summary: The goods deficit rose 2.1% to $134.9 billion, above the $130.2 billion economists expected, as imports rose $8.1 billion to $344.1 billion, much of it AI-related capital goods (Census Bureau via Reuters, 28 Oct). Third-quarter GDP is due on Thursday; a Reuters poll expects 3.2% annualised growth after 2.2% in the second quarter.

items.title: Wall Street ends higher; chip index up 3.6%
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7,722.60, the Nasdaq 1.18% to 26,477.81 and the Dow 0.03% to 52,377.57 on Tuesday (Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 27 Oct). The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained 3.6% to 11,482.51 and CoreWeave rose 7.9% (TradingKey, 27 Oct). Most S&P 500 stocks fell, with AI names leading the gains (AP, 28 Oct).

items.title: Boeing falls 10.7%; UPS up 5.8%
items.summary: Boeing dropped 10.7% after a bigger-than-expected third-quarter loss, while UPS rose 5.8% after raising its annual revenue and profit forecasts (Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 27 Oct).

items.title: Fed decides tonight: a hold is about 91% priced
items.summary: CME FedWatch futures imply a 91% chance the Fed holds rates today; the focus is whether it changes the odds of a December hike (Reuters via Kitco, 27 Oct). The target range is 3.75%–4.00% (Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 27 Oct). The 10-year Treasury yield was 4.99% early on Wednesday (AP, 28 Oct).

items.title: Asia closes higher: KOSPI +6.6% as SK Hynix jumps nearly 11%; Jio up over 20% on debut
items.summary: The KOSPI ended 6.6% higher on Wednesday, its highest in two weeks, as SK Hynix closed nearly 11% up after its results; the Nikkei rose 1.5%, the Hang Seng 0.2% and the Shanghai Composite 0.9% (Investing.com, 28 Oct). In India, Jio Platforms, backed by Meta and Google, opened at 1,358 rupees against an IPO price of 1,119 rupees and rose as much as 22.8% after raising $3.2 billion (Investing.com, 28 Oct).

items.title: UBS: third-quarter net profit up 8% to $2.69 billion, just below estimates
items.summary: UBS reported net profit of $2.69 billion for the quarter to 30 September, up from $2.48 billion a year earlier but just short of the $2.74 billion Bloomberg estimate, with a higher tax charge of $887 million; operating profit rose to $3.59 billion from $2.83 billion (Investing.com, 28 Oct).

items.title: Rand R16.68/$, Top 40 down 0.2% early; December Fed hike 84% priced
items.summary: The rand traded at 16.68 per dollar at 06:52 GMT, 0.2% weaker than its previous close, the Top 40 was down about 0.2% in early trade and the 2035 government bond yield rose 2 basis points to 8.6%. Traders expect no change from the Fed at 18:00 GMT, but CME FedWatch shows an 84% chance of a December hike; ETM Analytics said the rand could weaken beyond R17 if oil and Fed pressures persist (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 28 Oct).

items.title: Moody's: budget update is credit positive; Ba2 rating, positive outlook
items.summary: In a report released on Monday, Moody's said the medium-term budget policy statement was credit positive, citing continued fiscal consolidation despite higher oil prices; the 2026 consolidated deficit target was cut to 3.9% of GDP from 4.0%, helped by a R17.1 billion upward revision to tax revenue. Moody's sees debt at 84.9% of GDP by fiscal 2028, down from about 86.8% in fiscal 2025, but said interest absorbed 18.8% of revenue in fiscal 2025. There was no rating action (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 26 Oct).

items.title: South Africa's first gas-to-power tender fails on gas-supply concerns
items.summary: The 2,000 MW tender for private producers closed without a preferred bidder because bidders could not give the required assurances of gas supply, the energy and electricity ministry said on Wednesday; four bids totalling 2,830 MW were received in May, and no date was given for the next window (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 28 Oct).

items.title: JSE All Share up 0.63%; Naspers gains 2.5%
items.summary: The JSE All Share closed at 109,820.15 on Tuesday, up 689.83 points or 0.63%, with Naspers up 2.48% and AngloGold Ashanti up 1.63% (Trading Economics, 27 Oct).

items.title: Dollar at a two-week high; euro $1.1129, pound $1.3307
items.summary: The dollar index rose 0.3% to 102.40 on Tuesday, its highest since 14 October, and held steady early on Wednesday; the euro was flat at $1.1129, sterling at $1.3307 and the dollar at 158.03 yen (Reuters via Kitco, 27 Oct).

items.title: Gold eases 0.4% to $4,045 as the dollar firms
items.summary: Spot gold was down 0.4% at $4,045.45 an ounce and gold futures down 0.4% at $4,058.47 at 07:08 ET (11:08 GMT), with the dollar index up 0.1% at 102.42 before the Fed (Investing.com, 28 Oct). Earlier, platinum was $1,542.63 at 00:46 GMT (Investing.com, 28 Oct).

items.title: V: Visa beats but shares slip 2.3% after hours on a slower 2027 outlook
items.summary: Visa grew fiscal fourth-quarter revenue 13% to $12.1 billion with adjusted EPS of $3.48, above the $3.44 estimate, and raised its dividend 16% to 78 cents. It guided to low-double-digit revenue growth and low-double-digit to low-teens adjusted EPS growth for fiscal 2027, slower than 2026's 16%, and agreed to buy BioCatch for $2.4 billion; shares fell 2.3% after hours (Investing.com, 27 Oct) and were down 1.7% pre-market on Wednesday (Reuters via Investing.com, 28 Oct). V is a HOLD on the LRC Stock Scanner, capped by the $344 target; rating unchanged.

items.title: MSFT: Microsoft reports after tonight's close; Azure guide 44%–45%
items.summary: Consensus is about $90.6 billion of revenue and adjusted EPS of about $4.71 for the September quarter, with Azure guided to 44%–45% growth in constant currency and capex expected above $50 billion (FinanceFeeds, 28 Oct). MSFT is a HOLD on the LRC Stock Scanner, capped by the $512 target, with a trigger level at $515; rating unchanged.

items.title: GOOGL and META: Alphabet up 1.2% pre-market on OpenAI chip report before tonight's results
items.summary: The Information reported on Tuesday that OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips (TPUs); no terms were disclosed, and Alphabet's CFO expects most TPU sales revenue to be recognised in 2027 (Reuters via Investing.com, 27 Oct). Alphabet was up 1.2% pre-market and reports after Wednesday's close (Reuters via Investing.com, 28 Oct); Meta fell 1.6% on Tuesday after its equity fundraising (Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 27 Oct). Both are BUYs on the LRC Stock Scanner (targets $344 and $680); Meta is trading below its $633.70 trigger level; ratings unchanged.

items.title: BA and UPS: Boeing's 10.7% fall takes it further below its trigger
items.summary: Boeing's 10.7% drop after its third-quarter loss and UPS's 5.8% gain on a raised outlook were among Tuesday's biggest moves (Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 27 Oct). Boeing is a HOLD on the LRC Stock Scanner and now trades below its $184.40 trigger level; UPS is a HOLD; ratings unchanged.

items.title: NVDA, AMD and AVGO: chip rally continues
items.summary: The chip index rose 3.6% on Tuesday (TradingKey, 27 Oct), Nvidia gained 0.9% and Broadcom 4% after a $63 billion AI computing financing deal (AP, 28 Oct). NVDA, AMD and AVGO are BUYs on the LRC Stock Scanner; AMD reports on 3 November and Nvidia on 17 November; ratings unchanged.

watch_today: Fed decision at 20:00 SAST: a hold is expected; futures price an 84% chance of a December hike
Microsoft and Alphabet results after the US close (about 22:00 SAST onwards)
Oil: Saudi damage reports, Iran's formal reply to the Qatari draft (an official calls it "unacceptable"; reply due by the end of the week); US EIA crude stocks at 16:30 SAST
Israel: the count continues; double-envelope ballots could take until Friday
Rand near R16.68/$ (ETM Analytics flags R17 risk) and the JSE's reaction to oil, gas, the Fed and the chip rally
Coming up: Amazon and Intel results, US GDP (3.2% expected) and PCE, SA PPI (Thu); SA trade data and Bank of Japan (Fri); OPEC+ on Sunday 1 November
